name: Harmony
description: Consonance, Fit, The Arrangement In Which Nothing Is Fighting Anything Else. Built from Balance and Peace, Harmony is the Cognition of things working together — bodies, voices, a company, a spell. It heals by restoring a system to its proper relation, it fights by making an enemy's parts disagree with each other, and it is the direct opposite of Carnage, which is the state of everything coming apart at once.

major.name: Out of tune
major.card: its attacks and abilities work against each other — disadvantage on attacks

severe.name: Shattered chord
severe.card: Incapacitated as nothing about it agrees with anything else

supportive.name: In Concert
supportive.description: You put the company in tune. They stop working against each other and start compounding.

tiers.text: For 1 minute, while the target is within 30 feet of an ally, both add your Verum Modifier to damage rolls and to saving throws.
tiers.card: 1 min: within 30 ft of an ally, both get +{VM} damage and saves

tiers.text: When the target and an ally attack the same creature in the same round, the second attack has advantage.
tiers.card: Two of them on one target: the second attack has advantage

tiers.text: Once per round, when any ally within 30 feet of the target is healed, the target is healed for the same amount, and the reverse is true.
tiers.card: 1/round: healing one of them heals the other for the same

tiers.text: One Chord. Every ally within 30 feet of the target shares its senses, cannot be surprised, may use its reaction to act on any of the others' turns, and rolls all saving throws with advantage while at least three of them remain standing.
tiers.card: ONE CHORD — shared senses, reactions on each other's turns, advantage on saves while three still stand

offensive.name: Dissonance
offensive.description: Everything in them was agreeing with everything else. You stop that.

tiers.text: The damage becomes thunder, and deals Twice your Verum Modifier more for each other enemy within 10 feet of the target — the closer they stand, the worse they resonate.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Thunder · +2×VM per enemy standing within 10 ft of them

tiers.text: The note carries: every other enemy within 10 feet of the target takes a quarter of the damage, and all of them have disadvantage on Concentration until the end of their next turn.
tiers.card: Everyone crowded around them takes a quarter · all at disadvantage on Concentration

tiers.text: A creature hit or that fails can't benefit from an ally's aura, Help or shared effect until the end of its next turn — the chord has broken between them.
tiers.card: Cut off from allied auras, Help and shared effects

tiers.text: Breaking the Chord. A creature that fails comes apart from itself for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn: it may take an action, a bonus action or a reaction on its turn — one of the three, not several.
tiers.card: BREAKING THE CHORD — one action, bonus action OR reaction a turn, for 1 min

conditions.name: Discordant
conditions.escape: Charisma save at the end of each of its turns

control.name: The Common Key
control.description: The area picks a key. Everything in it has to play along or be heard failing to.

tiers.text: For 1 minute the area rings softly. A creature that fails has disadvantage on attack rolls against a creature it is not already engaged with — it cannot find the beat.
tiers.card: 1 min: those who fail can't switch targets cleanly — disadvantage on new ones

tiers.text: Creatures that failed can't take reactions, and any effect inside that requires two or more of them to cooperate simply fails.
tiers.card: No reactions · nothing that needs two of them working together functions

tiers.text: Your allies inside act as one: each may use another's initiative count, and none of them can be caught flanked, surrounded or separated while two remain.
tiers.card: Your allies share initiative and can't be flanked or split while two stand

tiers.text: Resolution. At the end of the minute, everything in the area returns to concord: all ongoing effects of the slot level or lower end, every creature is returned to its true form, and all temporary conditions on your allies are cleared at once.
tiers.card: RESOLUTION — at the end, everything ≤ slot ends, true forms return, and your allies are cleared

creation.name: Well-Tuned
creation.description: Your creations fit their place so precisely that the place is better for them.

tiers.text: Your creations never interfere with one another or with your allies: they grant no cover to enemies, never block a line of effect you want, and always stand where they are needed.
tiers.card: Creations never get in your way, and always stand where they're needed

tiers.text: Two or more of your creations within 30 feet of each other each gain +2 Armour Class and your Verum Modifier to damage.
tiers.card: Creations near each other: +2 AC and +{VM} damage apiece

tiers.text: Your Structures resonate: allies inside regain your Verum Modifier in hit points at the start of each of their turns, and enemies inside have disadvantage on Concentration.
tiers.card: Structures heal your allies {VM} a turn and spoil enemy Concentration

tiers.text: Raise a Consonance: a permanent Structure in which no two things can work against each other — no ambush, no betrayal, no spell that turns one creature on another functions inside it.
tiers.card: A CONSONANCE — permanent · no ambush, betrayal or turning works inside

utility.name: Concord
utility.description: Finding the arrangement in which everything fits, including people.

tiers.text: Know what is out of joint here: the failing part of a mechanism, the sick tree in the orchard, the person in the room who does not want this to work.
tiers.card: Know what's out of joint — the broken part, or the person spoiling it

tiers.text: Tune a thing back into working order: an instrument, a mechanism, a spell that has begun to fail, a body's rhythm — restored for a day.
tiers.card: Tune anything back into working order for a day

tiers.text: Set a company in concord for 24 hours: they cannot be turned against each other, misunderstand one another, or be separated by illusion or deception.
tiers.card: 24 hrs in which your company cannot be turned or divided

tiers.text: Resolve a discord that has stood for years: a feud, a curse laid in anger, a haunting, a land that will not grow — given a day's work and the willing presence of both sides.
tiers.card: Resolve a years-old feud, curse or haunting — with both sides willing

complementEffects.name: Off Key
complementEffects.description: The seal introduces a note that does not belong.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes bonus thunder damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6) and has disadvantage on its next Concentration check.
effect.card: +1 die thunder · disadvantage on their next Concentration check

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Two dice, and it can't benefit from an ally's aura or Help until the end of its next turn.
upgrades.card: +2 dice · cut off from allied auras and Help

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Three dice, and a further die for each other enemy within 10 feet of it.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · +1 more per enemy crowded around it

complementEffects.name: In Tune
complementEffects.description: The seal leaves its targets working as one thing.

effect.text: While within 30 feet of one another, each of the seal's targets adds your Verum Modifier to damage rolls until the end of its next turn.
effect.card: The seal's targets: +{VM} damage while they stay within 30 ft of each other

upgrades.text: Level 5+: It lasts 1 minute, and the second of them to attack a given creature each round has advantage.
upgrades.card: 1 min · the second attacker on a target has advantage

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Healing one of them heals another within 30 feet for the same amount, once per round.

complementEffects.name: Discord
complementEffects.description: The seal leaves them slightly out of step with each other.

effect.text: A creature hit by or failing the seal can't benefit from an ally's aura, Help or shared effect until the end of its next turn.
effect.card: No allied auras, Help or shared effects until their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: It also can't take reactions while it lasts.
Level 11+: If two or more creatures that failed are within 10 feet of each other, each has disadvantage on attack rolls.
upgrades.card: Crowded failures all attack at disadvantage
